body: On disconnect of the bound conn, rebind to the newest open conn of the same session whose claude_pid equals the session entry pid (any when the entry pid is unknown); alternative rejected: any open conn of the session, which would hand a resumed run to a stale link of the previous run.

Test isolation via one shared tests/common::{cctg,isolate} (strip every CCTG_* and CLAUDE* var, own HOME/USERPROFILE) plus tests/isolation.rs guard (static scan + inner-process check with inherited session/secret/addr); alternative rejected: adding env_remove lines per file, which is what leaked in stdout.rs.

Full workspace test failed twice (spool_e2e client_version field, supervise_e2e --trial-secs unknown) because the shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR target/debug/cctg.exe was overwritten by the sibling worktree build; fixed by touching main.rs and rerunning the affected binaries.
